structural_observation: For fixed embedding rows E and final hidden query h,the tied proposal softmax(h E^T) E has Jacobian E^T (diag(p)-p p^T) E,which is positive semidefinite. With distinct output rows W and input/value rows E,the corresponding cross-covariance need not be symmetric or PSD. The full causal body remains nonlinear;this local constraint does not prove the tied model cannot learn useful computation.
prospective_test: Only if justified after the fixed-one comparison: independently qualify untied input/output parameters and compare candidate with an equally untied ordinary control at equal parameters/exposure/work. Count extra parameters and measured cost. Do not attribute differences across published architectures to tying alone.
